title: The Karnataka Irrigation (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Irrigation (Amendment) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 32 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Other / Unclassified. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Karnataka Irrigation Act, 1965; Karnataka Act 16 of 1965) (hereinafter referred to as the principal Act; In section 6 of the principal Act across 10 identified sections/clauses.
